**Finding: MFN — compliant (preferred level).**

- The sole MFN provision (p1099, Attachment 1) obliges **MSL** to price its engineering to IBM on a "most favored customer" basis — an MFN in our favour, which the playbook expressly welcomes and directs us not to redline.
- Pricing provisions (§ 7.0, § 7.1, § 8.2) and full-text searches for "favorable", "no less favorable", "more favorable", best/lowest price, and match-third-party-offer language surfaced no reciprocal obligation on IBM.
- The tooling provision at p1104 gives **IBM** the right to match a bona fide third-party offer — again a Customer-side benefit, not a Customer MFN.

No redline proposed.
